claims.text: The site's own stated theory of how the craft works is not McCandlish's and is not sourced to him. Its TECH page lists 'Magnetohydrodynamics', 'Quasicrystals', 'Einstein-Rosen bridge theory', 'The Hutchinson effect' and 'Levels of consciousness' among 'Our current lines of thinking', and leans on Bob Greenyer of the Martin Fleischmann Memorial Project, a Lockheed Martin matterwave patent, Thomas Bearden and Malcolm Bendall. A reader who takes the site as a source on the 1990 account is reading two different things bound together.
